optimizedDescription.value: Hexagonal DDD: business logic stays domain-centered; I/O and delivery adapters live at outer edges.

optimizedContext.value:
# Architecture

## Rules
- Business-logic packages: `domain/`, `application/`, `infrastructure/`; optional `composition/`; inner layers never import outer
- `domain/`: no I/O (`fs`, `net`, `child_process`, HTTP); TypeScript stdlib + domain types only
- `application/`: external access only through `application/ports/`; never import infrastructure
- Entities own invariants/state transitions; invalid operations throw typed `SpecdError` subclasses; use cases do not duplicate entity checks
- Value objects expose behavior via methods/getters; internal representation inaccessible outside class hierarchy
- Ports with invariant constructor args: abstract classes, invariant fields set in constructor, explicit abstract methods; never property signatures
- Stateless domain services: exported functions in `domain/services/`, not classes
- Manual DI at application entry points; use-case constructors receive ports; no IoC or module singletons
- `composition/` alone imports `infrastructure/`; wires `createKernel(config, options?)`, `createDefaultConfigLoader()`, `createConfigWriter()`
- Kernel excludes config mutation; hosts use `kernel.project.getConfig`
- Each Kernel capability available without `createKernel`: canonical `createX(deps)`; optional `createX(config, options?)` delegates shared composition resolver
- `createKernel` and `createKernelBuilder` reuse resolver/factory path; no second composition source
- Public entry points never export concrete adapters; delivery hosts use `@specd/sdk` per `sdk:composition`
- YAML infrastructure reads validate at boundary; failures `ConfigValidationError`/`SchemaValidationError` extend `SpecdError`
- `@specd/cli`, `@specd/mcp`, `@specd/plugin-*`: delivery-only, no business logic
- Package dependency DAG: `plugin-*` → `skills` → `core`; `cli` → `sdk`; `mcp` → `sdk`; `sdk` → `core`, `code-graph`; `schema-*` no specd deps
- CLI MAY depend directly on `@specd/guide` only as guide delivery adapter; delegate catalog/topic/slice/search; MAY lazy-load `@specd/guide/sdk`
- Public exports: `"."` integrator API, `"./ports"` contracts, `"./extensions"` registry/factories, `"./internal"` dev-only; `@specd/sdk` re-exports `./ports`, `./extensions`

## Constraints
- `domain/` cannot import `application/`, `infrastructure/`, `composition/`; `application/` cannot import `infrastructure/`, `composition/`; `infrastructure/` cannot import `composition/`
- Only `composition/` imports infrastructure; no concrete adapters/repository factories from `index.ts` or public `"."` barrels
- Delivery imports factories/kernel/config ports only; may call returned ports; never imports infrastructure or directly constructs use cases
- No circular `workspace:*` dependencies
- YAML validated before domain/application construction; unvalidated YAML never crosses boundary
- Public `"."` exports Kernel-equivalent `createX` and repository-level factories for every Kernel capability
- Port contracts: `@specd/core/ports`, `@specd/sdk/ports`; extensions: `@specd/core/extensions`, `@specd/sdk/extensions`
- cli/mcp cannot directly depend on both `@specd/core` and `@specd/code-graph` when `@specd/sdk` suffices
